title: SessionSend
description: Deliver a message to the employee.

images.description: Images to deliver with the text (at most 8): image/png, jpeg, gif, webp or a PDF, at most 5 MB each. Kept for daemons without attachments_v2; see attachments.

attachments.description: Attachments to deliver with the text (at most 20), any type up to 200 MB each. Only sent to daemons with the attachments_v2 feature; a message carries either attachments or images, not both.

anchor.description: The task anchor (task id, instruction, branch, hand-off notes, progress). The daemon keeps the latest one and re-injects it after the runtime compacts the session during a task; an empty string clears it.
